question: Should Workspaces permanently support an approvals-queue builtin that can be placed in workspace documents and dispatch the existing custom-widget approval decision?
rationale: The patch can preserve the existing operator authorization boundary, but source inspection cannot decide whether approval controls should be composable workspace content or remain only in the canonical pending-widget flow.

options.title: Approve the builtin surface
options.body: Keep the queue limited to pending custom widgets, reuse the existing operator-only RPC, and require live authorization proof before merge.

options.title: Make it read-only
options.body: Show pending custom-widget requests in the widget but retain approve and reject actions only on the canonical operator surface.

options.title: Drop the approvals widget
options.body: Land only agent status and continue using existing pending-widget controls for approval decisions.

recommendation.title: Approve the builtin surface
recommendation.body: Keep the queue limited to pending custom widgets, reuse the existing operator-only RPC, and require live authorization proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They integrated and merged the current Workspaces architecture and approval boundary on main.
